programmes.d: Explore a new kind of electrified Mustang. Then, similar cars compete in the fun column.
Join Harry Metcalfe on the amazing three-day Lamborghini 50th anniversary tour.

A 1977 Corvette Stingray arrives with seven layers of paint and too many problems to count. The restoration makes no sense, but Dan takes it. A 1965 Cobra is brought in for a simple wiring job. Then, the owner decides to wrap the car like a fighter jet.

Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

When the 1941 Buick Coupe rolls into FantomWorks, it is the worst possible combination: a very difficult car and very demanding owner. Janelle wants her KZ-750 transformed into a cool stripped down ‘café’ bike – a challenge for FantomWorks new bike shop.

The owner of a C10 pick-up wants a full frame off restoration and as Dan predicted, things get ugly when they peel off the paint. A Heinkel came in with mismatched scooter parts hiding an incredibly rare car - which makes parts almost impossible to find.

A 1917 Overland will be FantomWorks oldest restoration, if they can solve this jigsaw puzzle of rotted wood and rusted steel. Dan buys a 1968 Camaro on the internet for his wife, Malissa, and finds out that the car is in extremely poor condition.

Brad wants a 1967 Mustang Coupe to be new again; so Dan has to fight the way the car was initially built by the factory. Jay wants a stunning 1965 TR4, but he plans to do most of the work himself. Instead, the Fantomworks side of the job keeps growing.

Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

When Gray brings his 1929 Phaeton in, Dan uncovers deadly dangers that lead to lifesaving repairs. Tony believes his 1989 Jeep Wrangler is 95% done, but the car is a rolling disaster of bad work, tangled wires and incompatible parts.
When Danny is asked to create a commemorative bike that honors music legend Les Paul he has to pull out all the stops.
Danny and the boys meet with a customer who wants a wicked paint job to match his wicked 1959 Anglia dragster.
Danny has a customer who wants to restore a 1942 Ford truck that saw some action in WWII. But when Danny takes in the project he quickly learns it'll need a lot more.
The shop has its hands full restoring a 1942 Ford truck that needed a lot of TLC and a special touch for the owner's wife. Danny and Ryan check out a badass 1929 Ford Roadster.
Danny scores a pimp-tastic 1967 Impala, but when it's time to hand over the keys to an important client Danny doesn't think he can let her go.
Legendary rocker George Lynch from the metal band Dokken stops by with his very cool 1965 Buick Riviera.
"Engine Whisperer" Doc has a cool '67 Firebird he's been working on. While he's a mechanical maestro under the hood, his paint skills are lacking so he enlists Ryan.
This two-part episode starts with a client asking Danny to find and build a 1979 Camaro Z28, to commemorate the first car he ever owned.
Danny's battle with nightmare Z28 continues as he puts it though endless fabrication to bring it back to life. While it's being revived, Danny takes a break.
Danny has wanted a Plymouth Roadrunner ever since a couple of car nuts pulled him over a few years ago, and bought his Sebring on the spot.
A customer wants to trick out his 2004 Harley Davidson Road Glide, but both Shannon and Ryan aren't sure they can do everything he wants.
Danny has found and bought a replacement for his beloved Dune Buggy "Sparkles." As the guys are turning it into the ultimate 70s beach fantasy.
Get a look at some stunning cars at the Quail show at the Pebble Beach weekend. Then, April fools.
Join Harry Metcalfe in a convertible Bentley in snowy Spain. Then, put a Lambo through its paces in Italy.
Harry Metcalfe drives a super-rare hypercar. Then, the greatest driving road in the world.

Dive into the P1's clever aerodynamic and cooling features. Then, see if it's faster than an RXC Turbo 500.
Drive a replica of the iconic Silverstone Circuit cut into a frozen lake. Then, meet the Vauxhall Maloo.

Head to Italy to drive the mighty Pagani Huayra and get a taste of the Veyron Vitesse. Then, a proper Ferrari?
Jethro investigates whether or not Ferrari has created another masterpiece. Then, an epic road trip.

Car reviews: McLaren 570S Spider, Eagle Low Drag GT, Porsche Cayman GTS and Alfa Giulia Quadrifoglio.

Watch the McLaren 750S take on the Ferrari 296 GTB. Then, enjoy a review of Ariel Atom 3.5R.
The Ferrari 488 Pista excels at Anglesey. Then, review the features of the Bugatti Chiron.
Porsche, Rimac and Maserati thrill with innovation. Then, review the 919 Hybrid at the Geneva Motor Show.
